title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Shows resilience below 38.2% Fibo. near mid-0.7100s
summary: The AUD/USD pair touches a one-and-a-half-week low, around the 0.7140 region during the Asian session on Monday, though it lacks follow-through. Spot prices currently trade just above mid-0.7100s, down nearly 0.25% for the day.

title: New Zealand Dollar weakens below 0.5800 on RBNZ dovish signals
summary: The NZD/USD pair tumbles to around 0.5790 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) weakens against the US Dollar (USD) on a dovish hike from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ).

title: Oil Prices Surge as Middle East Attacks Continue and Diplomacy Stumbles
summary: Oil prices initially jumped by over 3% in early Asian trade on Monday as fears of a major and extended supply disruption were stoked by continued attacks in the Middle East and the postponement of a crunch meeting between Gulf states and Iran. At the time of writing, both benchmarks had fallen back slightly, with WTI futures trading at $102.2 per barrel, 2.16% higher on the day, and Brent futures up 2.14% at $106.8 per barrel. title: Is Germany's economic slump finally over?
summary: Despite a slew of negative headlines, the German economy has posted its best figures in years. There are reasons for optimism, but structural issues remain.

title: Niger mutiny exposes growing reliance on Russia
summary: The attempted power grab has exposed deep grievances within the army and tested Niger’s ties with its Sahelian allies.
